items.name: Fake Hotel / Villa Booking
items.description: A fraudster advertises a property that is unavailable or not theirs.
items.warning_signs: Pressure to pay quickly; copied photos; no verifiable property.
items.protect_yourself: Verify the property and booking provider; keep receipts.

items.name: Fake Tour / Holiday Package
items.description: A very cheap package is offered and extra charges appear later or the provider disappears.
items.warning_signs: Unusually low price; urgency; no written terms.
items.protect_yourself: Use established providers and get written inclusions.

items.name: Fake Bike / Car Rental
items.description: A vehicle or rental provider may be misrepresented or fees changed later.
items.warning_signs: No agreement; unusual deposit; unclear damage policy.
items.protect_yourself: Photograph the vehicle and read the agreement.

items.name: Tout / Massage / Entertainment Scam
items.description: Unsolicited offers can lead to inflated bills or unwanted services.
items.protect_yourself: Use established businesses and agree prices first.

items.name: UPI / QR Code / Online Payment Scam
items.description: A person may send a QR code or request OTP/UPI PIN under a false pretext.
items.maps_query: UPI / QR Code / Online Payment Scam Goa
items.protect_yourself: Never share UPI PIN or OTP; verify the recipient.

items.name: Taxi / Transport Overcharging
items.description: A journey may be quoted at one amount and charged at another.

items.name: Unauthorised Beach Services
items.description: Unlicensed operators may charge for services or equipment without clear pricing.
items.warning_signs: No price board; no receipt; pressure.
items.protect_yourself: Use authorised operators and ask for a receipt.

items.name: Currency Exchange Fraud
items.description: An exchange can involve hidden commissions, poor rates or counterfeit notes.
items.warning_signs: No receipt; rushed counting; unclear rate.
items.protect_yourself: Use authorised exchangers and verify the rate.

items.name: Shopping / Tout Commission Scam
items.description: A tout may steer visitors to shops where prices include commissions.
items.protect_yourself: Compare prices and use established shops.

items.name: Fake Tickets / Unauthorised Travel Agent
items.description: Tickets or tours may be sold using false confirmations.
items.maps_query: Fake Tickets / Unauthorised Travel Agent Goa

items.name: Fake Official / Unofficial Cash Demand
items.description: Someone may falsely claim to be an official and demand immediate cash.
items.maps_query: Fake Official / Unofficial Cash Demand Goa
items.protect_yourself: Ask for official identification and a receipt.

items.name: Fake Booking / Refund / Customer-Care Call
items.description: A caller claims a booking/refund problem and asks for OTP, PIN or payment.
items.maps_query: Fake Booking / Refund / Customer-Care Call Goa
items.protect_yourself: Contact the company using its official website/app.

items.name: Drug / Illegal-Substance Trap
items.description: Visitors can be approached with illegal substances, creating legal and safety risks.
items.warning_signs: Unknown person offering drugs; pressure to carry.
items.protect_yourself: Do not accept, carry or purchase illegal substances.
